offering_description.value: Operates accredited allied health colleges that train post-secondary students for healthcare careers. Students pay for programs such as nursing, veterinary technology and medical imaging, taught on its own campuses.

quotes.quote: Meet Legacy Education: nationally accredited, award-winning allied health programs at 4 schools on 6 campuses. Explore our mission, values, and approvals.
